const job = $json;

// --------------------------------------------------
// 1. CV
// --------------------------------------------------

const cvNode = $('Extract CV Text').first().json ?? {};

const rawCvText =
  cvNode.text ??
  cvNode.content ??
  cvNode.data ??
  cvNode.extractedText ??
  '';

const cvText = String(rawCvText)
  .replace(/\r/g, '')
  .replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ')
  .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
  .trim();

// --------------------------------------------------
// 2. JOB DESCRIPTION
// --------------------------------------------------

const description = String(job.description ?? '')
  .replace(/\r/g, '')
  .replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ')
  .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
  .trim();

// --------------------------------------------------
// 3. PROMPT
// --------------------------------------------------

const aiPrompt = `
Use ONLY the job data provided below.

Do not browse the web.
Do not use external information.
Do not invent missing information.

You have TWO tasks:

1. Complete missing structured job fields ONLY when the answer
   can be reliably supported by the job title, description,
   criteria or already extracted job data.

2. Evaluate the technical/professional MATCH between the job
   and the candidate CV.


==================================================
GENERAL STRUCTURED FIELD RULES
==================================================

IMPORTANT:

- Preserve every field that is already populated.
- Only complete fields that are currently empty.
- Never replace a populated parser value.
- If the available job data does not reliably support an answer,
  return an empty string "".
- Do not guess.
- Do not use assumptions about the country, company or candidate.


==================================================
WORK MODE
==================================================

Allowed:

Remote
Hybrid
On-site
""

Only fill this field when the job data explicitly indicates:

Remote
Remoto
100% Remote
Hybrid
Híbrido
On-site
Onsite
Presencial

Never infer work mode from:

- city
- country
- office address
- transportation benefits
- company habits
- absence of the word Remote

If there is no explicit evidence:
""


==================================================
LANGUAGE
==================================================

Allowed:

English
Portuguese
""

Use the main language of the vacancy when clear from the
job content.

Do not infer employment type from language.


==================================================
PAYMENT
==================================================

Allowed:

Hourly
Fixed-price
Weekly
Monthly
Annual
Not specified
""

Only fill Payment when the job data explicitly supports the
payment frequency or payment model.

Examples:

per hour / hourly => Hourly
fixed price => Fixed-price
per week / weekly => Weekly
per month / monthly => Monthly
per year / annual / yearly => Annual

Do NOT infer Payment from:

- CLT
- PJ
- Full-time
- Part-time
- Contract

If no reliable evidence exists:
""


==================================================
TIME TYPE
==================================================

Allowed:

Full-time
Part-time
""

Examples:

Tempo integral => Full-time
Full-time => Full-time

Meio período => Part-time
Part-time => Part-time

IMPORTANT:

Full-time and Part-time describe TIME TYPE.

They do NOT determine Job Type.


==================================================
JOB TYPE
==================================================

Allowed values:

Contract
Internship
Freelance
Temporary
PJ
CLT
Long-term
""

Multiple values may be returned separated by comma and space
ONLY when multiple employment types are explicitly supported.

VERY IMPORTANT:

Job Type requires explicit evidence.

DO NOT infer Job Type from:

- Junior
- Senior
- Assistant / Assistente
- entry-level
- "starting your career"
- "learn in practice"
- training or mentorship
- Full-time
- Part-time
- Portuguese language
- Brazil location
- company nationality
- benefits
- permanent-looking responsibilities
- absence of another employment type

Internship:
Use ONLY when the vacancy explicitly says Internship, Intern,
Estágio, Estagiário or Estagiária.

A Junior role is NOT an Internship.

CLT:
Use ONLY when CLT is explicitly stated.

PJ:
Use ONLY when PJ or Pessoa Jurídica is explicitly stated.

Contract:
Use ONLY when Contract, Contractor or Contrato is explicitly stated.

Freelance:
Use ONLY when Freelance or Freelancer is explicitly stated.

Temporary:
Use ONLY when Temporary, Temporário or Temporária is explicitly stated.

Long-term:
Use ONLY when the job explicitly describes a long-term
engagement or long-term contract.

If employment type is not explicitly supported:
""


==================================================
EXPERIENCE
==================================================

Allowed values:

Senior
Mid
Specialist
Junior
Intern
Lead
""

IMPORTANT:

Experience is a MULTI-SELECT field.

When the vacancy explicitly covers more than one seniority level,
return multiple allowed values separated by comma and space.

Examples:

Pleno-sênior
Mid-Senior
Pleno/Sênior
Mid/Senior

=> "Mid, Senior"

Preserve the current value when already populated.

If missing, infer cautiously using:

- explicit seniority
- years requested
- responsibilities
- autonomy
- architecture ownership
- leadership scope
- complexity

Useful mappings:

Assistente / entry-level => Junior
Júnior / Junior => Junior
Pleno / Mid-level => Mid
Pleno-sênior / Mid-Senior => Mid, Senior
Sênior / Senior => Senior
Especialista / Specialist => Specialist
Lead / Tech Lead / Technical Lead => Lead
Estágio / Intern => Intern

Do NOT convert Junior into Intern unless the vacancy explicitly
identifies the role as an internship.

If multiple levels are explicitly supported, preserve all of them.


==================================================
SALARY
==================================================

Preserve the original currency and range when available.

Examples:

R$ 8.000 - R$ 10.000
USD 80,000 - 100,000
€50,000

If salary is not explicitly available:
""

==================================================
MATCH RULES
==================================================

MATCH measures ONLY technical and professional compatibility.

Allowed:

High
Medium
Low

DO NOT consider:

- Remote / Hybrid / On-site
- location
- salary
- employment model
- whether the candidate personally wants the job
- whether Qualified will later be Yeap or Nope

Match and work arrangement are completely independent.

Evaluate in this order:

1. Primary technical domain
2. Core responsibilities
3. Seniority and required scope
4. Required years of relevant experience
5. Core technologies and skills
6. Demonstrated projects / professional experience

Seniority and minimum experience requirements are CORE requirements,
not secondary preferences.

A strong technology overlap must NOT compensate for a clear mismatch
in required seniority or relevant professional experience.

HIGH

Use High when:

- the candidate strongly matches the primary domain;
- most core responsibilities are supported;
- seniority and required scope are reasonably compatible;
- required experience is reasonably compatible;
- several core technologies overlap;
- demonstrated experience suggests the candidate can perform
  most of the work;
- remaining gaps are mostly secondary or learnable.

Do NOT use High when there is a clear seniority or minimum-experience gap.

MEDIUM

Use Medium when:

- the primary domain clearly matches;
- several important technologies/responsibilities overlap;
- seniority and experience are reasonably close to the requirement;
- but meaningful gaps remain in some core technologies,
  architecture, infrastructure, production experience or scope.

Medium is appropriate for a MODERATE gap.

Do NOT use Medium to rescue a candidate whose technical stack overlaps
but whose demonstrated seniority or relevant experience is clearly
below a core requirement.

LOW

Use Low when ANY of the following creates a major professional mismatch:

- the primary domain is substantially different;
- most core responsibilities are unsupported;
- overlap is superficial or peripheral;
- the vacancy explicitly requires a seniority level that the CV
  does not reasonably support;
- the vacancy requires substantially more relevant professional
  experience than the CV demonstrates;
- the role requires leadership, architecture ownership, autonomy,
  production responsibility or scope substantially beyond what
  the CV demonstrates.

A vacancy may therefore be Low even when several technologies match.

Technology overlap alone does NOT justify Medium when a core seniority,
experience or responsibility requirement is clearly unmet.

==================================================
YEARS OF EXPERIENCE
==================================================

Compare years only when the vacancy provides an explicit requirement
and the CV provides enough evidence for a reasonable comparison.

Small differences should NOT be treated as automatic mismatches.

Example:

Job asks for 5 years.
Candidate demonstrates around 4-4.5 relevant years.

If seniority, responsibilities and demonstrated capability are otherwise
well aligned, this small difference should have little impact.

However, a LARGE experience gap is a core mismatch.

Examples:

- a Senior role requiring 5-6+ years of relevant experience when the CV
  clearly demonstrates substantially less relevant experience
  should normally be Low;

- a role requiring several years of leadership or architecture ownership
  when the CV does not demonstrate that scope should normally be Low;

- matching Python, AI, automation or other technologies does not override
  a substantial experience or seniority gap.

Do NOT invent the candidate's total years of experience.

Use only dates, durations and experience explicitly supported by the CV.

When exact years cannot be reliably calculated, compare the demonstrated
scope and seniority qualitatively instead of inventing a number.


==================================================
YEARS OF EXPERIENCE
==================================================

Years are supporting evidence, not a rigid filter.

Example:

Job asks for 5 years.
Candidate demonstrates around 4-4.5 relevant years.

This difference should have little impact when the candidate
clearly demonstrates the required capability.

A larger gap matters more when it also reflects a real gap in:

- responsibility
- complexity
- autonomy
- architecture
- leadership
- production experience
